**Hint 1:** To determine the updated values of $	heta_0$ and $	heta_1$ after one iteration of gradient descent, you need to compute the gradient of the loss function $L(	heta)$ with respect to each parameter. Remember that the loss function is $L(	heta) $$=$$ $$y_i$$ - f_{	heta}(x_i)$.

**Hint 2:** Since both $	heta_0**{(0)}$ and $	heta_1**{(0)}$ are initialized to $$0$$, evaluate the partial derivatives of the loss function with respect to $	heta_0$ and $	heta_1$ at these initial values. Use these derivatives to update the parameters according to the gradient descent update rule: $	heta**{(1)} $$=$$ 	heta**{(0)} - \alpha \cdot 
abla L(	heta**{(0)})$, where $\alpha$ is the learning rate.
